name: Tourist eVisa (eVisaCuba)
summary: Electronic single-entry tourist visa that replaces the paper Tourist Card. Apply online, at a Cuban consulate, or through a travel agency. Visa-free nationalities were not confirmed.

other: Passport valid at least 6 months from entry
Medical insurance is mandatory and checked at customs; you can buy it from Asistur on arrival
Visa-free country list not confirmed from an official page

stay.note: Tourist stay is up to 90 days, extendable by 90 more days. Extension steps were not confirmed.

steps: Apply at evisacuba.cu, a Cuban consulate, or through a travel agency
Complete the D'Viajeros form before travel

name: D'Viajeros entry declaration
summary: Required online health and customs form for travelers entering Cuba. You get a QR code to show on arrival. It is not a visa. The portal itself blocked automated reading, so details are unconfirmed.

other: Complete the form at dviajeros.mitrans.gob.cu before travel
Details read from Cuba Travel page only
